spec.title: AI o11y — Problem Employees
spec.description: Per-user anomaly catch for SupportBot. Surfaces token-glutton bursts (10-50x output tokens for 2 min) and runaway-loop bursts (10-50 calls/min for 3 min) emitted by the supportbot-anomalies k6 scenario. Same panels catch real-world anomalies of the same shape.

spec.title: Top output-token user (5m)
spec.description: User with the highest output-token burn in the last 5 minutes. Catches the token-glutton anomaly (one user requests huge documents).

spec.title: Top call-rate user (5m)
spec.description: User firing the most LLM calls in the last 5 minutes (per minute). Catches the runaway-loop anomaly (one user stuck in a retry loop).

spec.title: Output tokens/min by user — top 5 (5m rate)
spec.description: Output-token rate per acme.com user. A user pegging high above the pack is a token-glutton spike.

spec.title: Calls/min by user — top 5 (5m rate)
spec.description: LLM-call rate per acme.com user. A user pegging 10-50x the others is a runaway-loop spike — k6 anomaly scenario runs 180s bursts.

spec.title: acme.com calls/min by provider (5m rate)
spec.description: All acme.com SB user traffic split by provider. Anomaly bursts pin preferred_provider=ollama so spikes shouldn't move the anthropic line.

spec.title: Top conversations by tokens (24h)
spec.description: Top SupportBot conversations by output tokens in the last 24 hours. 24h window keeps bursts visible all day so the table is stable, not churning every minute as the 1h boundary slides. Anomaly bursts (sess_anomrun_* / sess_anomglut_*) bubble to the top — token-glutton bursts dominate the output column, runaway-loop bursts dominate input. The Cost column reads $0 for Ollama (no per-token pricing configured) and real $$ for Anthropic chats. Click the Conversation cell to open it in AI o11y.

spec.title: Worst employees by avg eval score (24h)
spec.description: Per-employee aggregate over the last 24h. Sessions = distinct conversation_ids the employee opened. Avg Eval Score is the mean of all scored conversations for that user — lower = the AI was less valuable for what they were asking. Repeat offenders surface here even if no single conversation is huge.
